rebuild_intent.summary: A compact religious structure featuring a tiered pagoda-style roof with multiple overhanging slab layers. The main body is constructed from stonebrick with wooden accents and decorative gold blocks. A central entrance with white/light colored door is flanked by gold ornamental blocks. The footprint is a small square with a cross-shaped floor plan visible from above.
